articles.title: Colossal Cretaceous Octopus Dwarfed Even Giant Marine Reptiles
articles.summary: Fossil jaws reveal a whale-sized octopus that lived over 72 million years ago. At up to 63 feet long, it may be the largest invertebrate ever, challenging top ocean predators for dominance.

articles.title: NASA's ERNEST Rover Drives Itself 16 Miles, Paving the Way for Smarter Space Exploration
articles.summary: A new rover prototype completed a 16-mile autonomous trek in the California desert, using AI and a novel suspension to navigate tough terrain. It could lead to faster, more capable explorers on the moon and Mars.

articles.title: Spain's 2026 Total Solar Eclipse: Why You Must Leave Madrid and Barcelona for the Real Show
articles.summary: The August 12, 2026, total solar eclipse will cross northern Spain, but a 99.96% partial eclipse in Madrid won't cut it. Here are the top cities inside the path of totality for the full twilight experience.
